svg.desc: Two lanes explain the remaining token-release rows without adding project milestones. F08.4e.7.d.1 fresh private release authorization is source-landed in c26c9e783b203f14f11505719af80bea2ad7fc8d. F08.4e.7.d.2 committed-original packet, commit and effects verification is source-landed in b7be5cbdf2ef75eda606b025032943dc0812bcb9. F08.4e.7.d.3 completion-to-release proof is source-landed in 8d915515dd7296ef0f73bc5afe56e0d8db8f06f0: distinct enrolled producer, genuine committed originals and independent release-purpose verification, without a second historical replay. F08.4e.7.d.4 durable exact outcome is source-landed in 73a7f82b7aacdb5f4e323715ccde1c264330d81a: separate root storage authorization, independent checkpoint and first-exact outcome retention. Row 15 exact committed-original release remains in progress: d.5 guarded token opening is NEXT/open, queued and not active; d.6 uncertain-outcome recovery remains open. Row 16 cold private handoff has five open diagnostics: F08.4e.7.e.1 root bootstrap and key delivery; e.2 isolated cold service; e.3 bounded private transport; e.4 independent response verifier; e.5 authorized private handoff. Every task has a visible name and written status as well as a colored segment, and links to its ledger criterion. These eleven nested diagnostics are not eleven new project milestones or effort estimates. Parent token release remains 14/16 source-landed, 1 in progress and 1 open; production acceptance remains 0/6 verified. A retained outcome is not token disclosure, latest-state witness proof or later public/portal permission. Source only, unbuilt, unexecuted and unprovisioned; no plaintext release, deployed service or current-session claim.
